text:
marta: quick sync after the manifest-v2 RFC review. we need a non-disruptive path to move from per-layer shards to range-based shards. proposing: background converter + short-lived warmup leases. thoughts?

liam: +1 on background converter. important we never take nodes out of rotation for whole-cluster restarts. converter should emit a readiness marker before swap.

anya: for leases: AcquireLease(shard, holder, ttl). holder must heartbeat via monotonic timer. server enforces ttl. if holder misses heartbeats, reclaim. also: expose /debug/force-release for SRE.

praveen: agree. conversion must be atomic from serving POV. plan: write new-shard.tmp -> validate checksum -> write new-shard.final -> CAS update manifest. manifest update must be idempotent, versioned, and tolerate partial writes.

ben: fallback hierarchy idea for incoming RPCs during migration: 1) mmap legacy shard if present, 2) open-range read from object store (stream), 3) redirection to warmup queue (low priority). increment metric fallback.path{type}.

chris: sketch of a manifest fragment with warmup/lease metadata (toy):

```json
{
  "manifest_version": 2,
  "model": "rw/llama-32",
  "shards": [
    {
      "id": "r0",
      "path": "s3://models/rw/llama-32/range-0.safetensors",
      "layout": "range",
      "warmup_hint": "initial",
      "lease_ttl_sec": 180
    }
  ]
}
```

marta: good. add warmup_priority and checksum fields. also we should record converter version in manifest so we can trace regressions.

liam: runtime primitives I can implement: LeaseManager with fast local cache + central S3/GCS manifest as source of truth for long-lived leases. eviction callback on low-memory to drop KV cache.

anya: tests: clock-drift treadmill (simulate host pause) + TTL aggressiveness matrix. recommend default ttl 3m for initial rollout.

praveen: converter requirements: bi-directional convert (legacy <-> range), offline validation step (safetensors schema + sha256), and a throttling limiter to avoid saturating network/IO. converter should be able to annotate per-shard conversion status in a sidecar index.

ben: ops runbook draft for rollout: convert 2% nodes -> monitor fallback.rate and warmup_latency -> double rollout cadence if fallback < 0.5% and warmup latency < 50ms. keep manifest-v1 readable for 14 days.

deploy-bot: conversion-job started job-783 converting rw/llama-32 range shards on gpu-12

chris: runtime concern: mixed-version serving risks cross-version KV cache incompat. ensure KV cache keyspace version embedded in manifest + eviction on lease handoff.

marta: good call. include cache_version and require allocator to free on lease release transition. also add warmup_progress_gauge{shard}=bytes_warmed/total_bytes.

liam: metrics we need: lease_acquire_total, lease_release_total, conversion_success_total, conversion_fail_total, warmup_progress_gauge, fallback_count_total{type}. I'll put these into the observability board.

anya: SRE notes: force-release must be constrained (audit log + 2-step confirmation). also expose last_heartbeat and holder_id for debugging.

praveen: conversion-backpressure: when a node is doing too many concurrent conversions, it should mark itself as conversion_saturated in the cluster registry so orchestrator reduces assignment. prevents IO storms.

ben: ops: watch egress costs during conversion (large models => big S3 read). set node-level rate limiter and global throttle policy.

marta: action items: I'll draft addendum covering manifest-v2 fields (checksum, warmup_hint, warmup_priority, lease_ttl_sec, cache_version, converter_version). Liam + Praveen to prototype LeaseManager + converter daemon. Ben to own rollout dashboard. Chris to add safetensors validator pre-publish hook.

chris: quick pseudocode for Lease API usage:

```
// acquire lease
if (LeaseManager.acquire(shardId, nodeId, ttl)) {
  startWarmup(shardId);
  while (warming) LeaseManager.heartbeat(shardId, nodeId);
  LeaseManager.release(shardId, nodeId);
} else {
  fallbackServe(shardId);
}
```

marta: also, small rollback plan: if converted shards fail validation in 1% of requests, revert manifest CAS to previous version and mark converter_version bad. we need automated alerts on conversion_fail_total > threshold.

sre-oncall: add an incident playbook: steps to force-release leases, pin manifest to previous version, and pre-warm affected nodes by manually queuing warmup jobs. include runbook links.

liam: one more: ensure converter writes a compact mapping file for index offsets so legacy readers can consult it during transition (compat shim). reduces cold-fallbacks.

anya: :thumbsup: let's be conservative on TTL for first week and iterate. I'll send a test matrix for heartbeats and pause scenarios.

marta: awesome. i'll open the RFC addendum PR with the manifest schema and the lease API sketch. ping me if you want to pair on the rollout dashboard metrics names.

ben: thanks everyone.
